ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to the study of sedentary behavior and cognition: This course will focus on developing basing understanding of concepts and methods in the study of sedentary behavior and cognitive functions. Students will become familiar with principles of objective assessment of sedentary behavior (accelerometer deployment and basics of data quality assessment) and learn about components of multidimensional construct of sedentary behavior. They will also become familiar with cognitive assessments used in sedentary behavior and cognitive function research.
